operator_intent_summary: Verify that the app-wide BNA brand shell request is actually satisfied across Operations, parent, student, provider, login, and public/external entry pages, including static branded toolbar, light professional palette, mobile-first section menus, top filters, in-app dropdowns, preserved button behavior, screenshot evidence, and live smoke.

Implement a crisp light BNA brand shell across Operations, parent/student/provider/external pages.

static branded toolbar, blue/yellow/light-orange palette, mobile-first side/sandwich section menus, top filters, in-app dropdowns instead of native mobile select sheets where supported, and no loss of existing button behavior.

expanded_phrases.million-dollar: The shell must look intentional and operator-grade: stable toolbar, readable typography, no horizontal overflow, consistent cards/controls, registered actions, and fresh screenshot/live-smoke evidence.
expanded_phrases.polish: Spacing, palette, button states, filters, dropdowns, and mobile menu behavior must be consistent and verifiable, not merely claimed.
expanded_phrases.crisp: UI surfaces should use restrained light styling, 8px control/card radii where applicable, aligned controls, and non-overlapping text.
expanded_phrases.GHL-like: Use first-party BNA SaaS navigation patterns only; do not add GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM APIs, or external writes.
expanded_phrases.mobile: 390px and 430px routes must be usable with side/sandwich menu behavior, no horizontal overflow, and touch-safe controls.
expanded_phrases.portal: Parent, student, provider, and login surfaces must carry the shared BNA shell while preserving each role's private scope.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: GHL-like means first-party BNA Operations/portal shell patterns: sticky topbar, side menu, top filter rail, in-app select menu, and action-state preservation inside BNA-owned code.
